note: Guyana: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for the stays shown (CARICOM members 6 months, most others 90 days, some 60, 30 or 14); everyone else needs a visa. Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Guyana
sources.said: Citizens of the following countries and territories may enter Guyana without a visa for the following period: Indefinite period British Virgin Islands 180 days Panama 6 months Antigua and Barbuda Barbados Belize Dominica Grenada Jamaica Saint Kitts and Nevis Saint Lucia Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Suriname Trinidad and Tobago 90 days Albania Argentina Austria Australia Bahamas Belgium Botswana Brazil Canada Chile Cuba Denmark Ecuador Finland France Germany Ghana Greece Hong Kong Ireland Italy Japan Luxembourg Montserrat Netherlands New Zealand North Korea Norway Peru Portugal Qatar Russia Spain Sweden Switzerland United Arab Emirates United Kingdom United States Uruguay 90 days within any 180 days Colombia 60 days Eswatini Malaysia 30 days Cayman Islands Costa Rica Dominican Republic Kuwait Maldives Singapore South Africa South Korea Turks and Caicos Islands 14 days Lesotho
